rows.en: Here ya go, one mooore~!!
...Against this thing, there's no end to it!
...With a guy like this for an opponent, there's no end to it!!
...At this rate, there's no end to it!
...At this rate, we'll be at it forever!!
...There's no end to it! ...A Gundam like this...!
...There's no end to it!
...With a guy like this for an opponent, there's no end to it!!
...With a guy like this for an opponent, there's no end to it!!
...At this rate, there's no damn end to it!!
...With a guy like this for an opponent, there's no end to it!!
I've found you, Gundam Heaven's Sword!! You lackey of the Devil Gundam!!
You... You're God Gundaaaam~~!!
Where is the Devil Gundam!!
Shut uuup!! I'm gonna crush youuuu~~~!!
No choice, then... In that case, I'll just have to defeat you!!
My hand is burnin' red!! Its loud roar tells me to grasp victory!!
Erupting...! ...Goooood!! Fingerrrrr!!!
...Gwah, how could the great me be beaten!! Gwaaaaaaaaargh!!
God Gundam... So this is the King of Hearts that one spoke of...
God Gundam... It's overwhelming...

God Gundam... What incredible power...
...It seems the Devil Gundam isn't in this Cube.
But Heaven's Sword is one of the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings...
Then could it be in another Cube...? It's possible...
What!!
A boulder suddenly came crashing down and blocked the path!!
That's...!?
Red King! You're the one who threw that boulder, aren't you!!
Red King! Was it you!? Did you throw that boulder!!
Bring it on, then!! I'll take you on!!
What...? Doesn't it intend to attack...?
...!! Did you throw that boulder!?
...!! Did you throw that boulder!?

...!! Did you throw that boulder!?
So you're the one who chucked that rock! That's dangerous, dammit!!
...!! Did you throw that boulder!?
...!! Did you throw that boulder!?
...!! Did you throw that boulder!?
What...? It's not going to attack...?

It's not going to attack...? It only blocked our path...
It's not going to attack...? It only blocked our path...
You're not gonna fight!? You just block the road and that's it!?
What...? Doesn't it intend to attack...?
What...? Doesn't it intend to attack...?
What...? Doesn't it intend to fight...!?
You again!!
You... again!!
This thing... It's the same one as before...
This thing... It's the same one as before...
This thing... It's the same one as before...
This thing... It's the same one as before...
This thing again!! It gives me the creeps!!
This thing... It's the same one as before...
This thing... It's the same one as before...
This thing... It's the same one as before...
Kiiigwaaaah!!!
Kiiiiih!! Gwaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!
Grrruuu...
Tch, this again!! What's it scheming!? This is way too suspicious!!
Now, now, calm down. The cross is close by.
Is there some way we could break that boulder?

notes.note: Leader-variant order from the 0326 script (second Pt_Chara_Check chain): #0.59-#0.68 = Mebius, Zero, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero, OOO, W, Den-O, RX. Identical Japanese (#0.60/#0.65/#0.66/#0.68) kept identical.
00 (Setsuna): 'A Gundam like this...!' kept as an unfinished fragment, as in the source.
??? is God Gundam before his name is shown (reply #0.71 names him).

God Finger chant: first line uses the glossary catchphrase 'My hand is burnin' red!'. Bakunetsu rendered 'Erupting' (#0.76), after the English dub's 'Erupting Burning Finger'; 'God Finger' kept as the attack name.
'Yatsu' = whoever told Yapool about the King of Hearts (likely the owner of the Cube the DG Cells came from); kept gender-neutral as 'that one'.

Variant order (third chain in 0326): #0.80-#0.89 = Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero, Mebius, Zero, OOO, W, Den-O, RX. #0.87 = W (Philip's 'zokuzoku suru ne' -> 'giving me chills'); #0.88 Den-O climax line; #0.82 00 asks if it's a Gundam.
Devil Gundam 'shitenno' rendered 'Four Heavenly Kings' (not in glossary).
Rock rendered singular 'boulder' throughout (next slice: 'that rock was abnormally hard').

0328 script branches Ultras vs others. #0.6/#0.7 = Mebius/Zero; #0.9/#0.10 = Zero/Mebius (remapped); #0.15-#0.22 = OOO, W, Nu, Zeta, Den-O, 00, Wing Zero, RX; #0.24-#0.31 = W, OOO, Zeta, Nu, Den-O, Wing Zero, 00, RX; #0.36-#0.45 = Mebius, Zero, OOO, W, Nu, Zeta, Den-O, Wing Zero, 00, RX; #0.56 Mebius (first of the last chain, rest in story_054).
Red King has g=n: 'it'. Identical Japanese #0.10/#0.25/#0.29/#0.30 kept identical.
No speaker recovered; silent Red King beat between the variant blocks.
??? = the silent entity that possessed Gomora in 0321 (called 'that thing' there), so 'this thing'/'it' here and in Ankh's #0.54.
Red King roars new to the corpus; styled after Gomora's ('Gyaaaah', 'Grrruuu...').

report: 80/80 rows. Variant orders taken from the 0326/0328 event scripts (Pt_Chara_Check chains). New: Red King roars, 'Four Heavenly Kings', 'King of Hearts', God Finger chant ('Erupting'). ??? in 0328 = the Gomora-possessing entity, 'it'.
